summary: Admission eligibility for PwD candidates in medical courses; NEET (UG) 2024; speech and language disability exceeding 40%; NMC regulation disqualifying candidates with 40%+ disability; medical board assessment confirming no impediment to MBBS studies; RPwD Act 2016 vs NMC eligibility criteria; constitutional right to education under Article 41; reasonable accommodation; appeal allowed restoring eligibility.
legal_provisions_cited: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 s.2(m), s.2(r), s.2(y), s.3, s.15, s.32
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; appellant directed to be admitted against reserved seat; NMC's blanket disqualification policy set aside for appellant.
